keyEvents.text: Penalty saved. Ross Stewart (Swansea City) right footed shot saved in the bottom left corner by Ryan Allsop (Birmingham City).
Delay in match because of an injury Ryan Allsop (Birmingham City).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Marko Stamenic (Swansea City) is shown the red card for violent conduct.
Goal! Birmingham City 1, Swansea City 0. Jay Stansfield (Birmingham City) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Max Bird.
Ross Stewart (Swansea City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Birmingham City 1, Swansea City 0.
Substitution, Swansea City. Joshua Key replaces Eom Ji-Sung.
